caption: New Fortress, Corfu
composition: Venetian bastions above the old port · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The New Fortress rises above Corfu's old port as two levels of pale bastions, with a dry moat at the base and a long British barrack block on the upper wall. The morning is clear, about 20.6°C. This is the landward Neo Frourio, not the Old Fortress and not the Liston.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the New Fortress of Corfu above the old port

qc_notes.note: Gate 1 hold — inter-format subject disagreement, verified by Cosmo QC 2026-09-26 on both masters: the 4:5 shows a prominent clock tower rising above the fortress complex, while the 16:9 shows clear sky above the barrack block with no tower — the two formats disagree on a defining feature (the build note itself anchors 'no clock tower; that clock belongs to the Old Fortress', which the 4:5 contradicts). Awaiting builder re-render or rework resolving which side is correct.
